scenario.title: Dense PII + Multi-Weapon Conflict + Compound Forced Entry
scenario.narrative: At 02:40 on 2026-10-04, Officer Marcus Brody (Badge #5912) and Sgt. Elena Rostova (Badge #1104) responded to a 911 dispatch from resident Jonathan Vance (Phone: 312-555-0812, SSN: 334-12-8891) at 1440 South Michigan Ave, Apt 4B, Chicago. The victim stated that two male suspects (one referred to as 'Demetrius') initially attempted to jimmy the ground-floor rear fire escape window with a crowbar, but failed, and then kicked in the rear kitchen door. One suspect brandished a concealed black semi-automatic pistol with an extended magazine while the second suspect struck the victim across the shoulder with a metal pipe wrench. Suspects looted a safe containing bearer bonds and jewelry, then fled southbound on foot toward Roosevelt Rd. Dispatched EMS unit 14 for victim care.

scenario.title: Rooftop Infiltration via Thermal Torch & Sophisticated Egress (Zero Violence)

The suspect descended into the main showroom via climbing ropes, disabled motion sensors using signal jamming equipment, and extracted high-value oil paintings with zero physical violence. No firearms or bladed weapons were brandished. CSI Officer Miller (Badge #9931) recovered thermal cutting residue and synthetic fiber samples.
